title: GitHub - vladforfutdinov/health-bar: macOS menu bar status of GitHub, OpenAI, Claude, Vercel, Supabase, etc.
excerpt: macOS menu bar status of GitHub, OpenAI, Claude, Vercel, Supabase, etc. - vladforfutdinov/health-bar
content_html:
HealthBar

macOS menu bar app showing the status of the services you depend on (GitHub, OpenAI, Claude, Vercel, Supabase by default).

Install

brew install --cask vladforfutdinov/healthbar/healthbar

Features

  • One ring for everything. One sector per checked service (at most 10), problems first, worst first; green fills the rest.

  • A row per service: its status, the current incident, and a 30-day uptime strip; a click opens the status page.

  • About 120 built-in status pages in groups, plus any Atlassian Statuspage or incident.io page, or your own that serves the same JSON (docs/STATUS_API.md).

  • Keyboard and VoiceOver reach every service in the menu; Settings works from the keyboard too.

  • Automatic updates.

Colours, menu, Settings and where the data comes from: docs/USAGE.md. The built-in pages: docs/SERVICES.md.

Develop

swift test
scripts/build.sh && open "dist/HealthBar (dev).app"

Releasing: docs/RELEASING.md.

License

MIT, see LICENSE.
